content:
Antigua offers a perfect blend of adventure and relaxation. If you are planning a romantic getaway to Antigua, you will find endless opportunities to create unforgettable memories.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Antigua
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets

![Romantic Antigua](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1662154477069-c8c0a5361a4c?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

Cooking classes for two let you learn the secrets of Antigua's cuisine while bonding over delicious food.

## Where to Stay

Luxury resorts with private pools and ocean views create the ultimate romantic atmosphere in Antigua.
